source.label: Manual autonomous collector adjudication — YC Spring 2026
notes: Rows are physical sources absent by platform post ID and normalized URL from public, targeted, a16z, and logged-in canonical evidence.
X publication timestamps were deterministically decoded from native snowflake IDs and cross-checked against the public reader Published Time.
Login/signup shell text was removed; each retained body is the native post body visible in rawVisibleText.

evidence.title: Russell Smith on returning to YC for Spring 2026
evidence.text: Having done YC before, it's amazing to be back. The energy is the same 14 years on. The quality of the folks I met was just as high, if not more, and all are moving super fast.
evidence.rawVisibleText: Native X post by Russell Smith (@rhs), Published Time 2026-04-01T20:00:48Z, 11K Views. Public-reader author URL and status URL both resolve to @rhs.
evidence.matchReason: Native post from the roster founder's mapped X account; author handle, account URL, native status ID, visible metrics, and X snowflake timestamp agree.

evidence.title: Auto-research to find new materials
evidence.text: Auto-research to find new materials. Instead of optimising a neural network, you can ask Claude to propose new materials. It searched 4,300 candidates over three days and verified 1,300.
evidence.rawVisibleText: Native X post by Advaith Sridhar (@advaith_sridhar), Published Time 2026-04-18T18:49:38Z, 11.7K Views. Public-reader author URL and status URL agree.
evidence.matchReason: Native post from the roster founder's mapped X account; the materials-research body is directly relevant to matforge and has positive visible metrics.

evidence.title: Ethan Shea on iPhone mirroring
evidence.text: Just discovered the iPhone mirroring app — I love it. So useful for when my pocket is a little cold and I need something to heat it up.
evidence.rawVisibleText: Native X post by Ethan Shea (@ethshea), Published Time 2026-07-29T02:57:00Z, 111 Views. Login/signup shell was excluded from the post body.
evidence.matchReason: Native activity from the roster founder's unique mapped X account with a readable primary post body and positive public views; attributed as founder account-owner activity, not as a company-subject claim.
